projects.name: FITMAN
projects.one_line: Full-stack AI fitness and nutrition coaching platform with LangGraph agents and a FastAPI backend.
projects.problem: Personalized workout and nutrition coaching is hard to keep consistent without structured user context.
projects.goal: Adaptive macros, workouts, logging, and an AI coach with persistent context.
projects.nabil_contribution: Portfolio materials describe Nabil as the engineer of the full-stack app (React/Vite frontend, FastAPI backend, Supabase, LangGraph agent state). This repository does not contain FITMAN source, so contribution claims are taken from portfolio documentation, not from a code audit.
projects.architecture: Client UI → FastAPI gateway → LangGraph state machine → Groq LLM → Supabase PostgreSQL. Source notes also describe a CoachState TypedDict covering profile, workout, nutrition, memory, and document context.
projects.data_flow: Not fully documented beyond the high-level architecture above.
decisions: Stateful LangGraph agent rather than a single-turn chatbot (documented intent).
projects.results: A public demo URL is listed in the portfolio. User counts and production SLAs are not documented.
limitations: This portfolio repo does not include FITMAN source code.
Knowledge-base notes originally labeled FITMAN as a planned project; UI copy later called it production.
Canonical status is active_development with a listed demo, not audited production.

evidence.description: Demo URL listed in portfolio (not load-tested here)
Original notes describe FITMAN as a larger planned project

projects.conflict_resolution: Source notes say planned; site copy said Active Production. Without source in this repo, status is active_development. Do not call FITMAN production. Do not cite <300ms Groq latency as a verified benchmark.

projects.name: Nabil Portfolio Technical Digital Twin
projects.one_line: This repository's evidence-grounded RAG agent over structured portfolio knowledge.
projects.problem: Visitors need accurate answers about Nabil without marketing hype or hallucination.
projects.goal: Canonical knowledge → hybrid retrieval → claim-aware grounded generation.
projects.nabil_contribution: Designed and implemented the Next.js portfolio, FastAPI RAG service, Pinecone indexing, and digital-twin policy in this repository.
projects.architecture: Visitor → Next.js → FastAPI → query classification → entity resolution → canonical knowledge + Pinecone dense retrieval + lexical overlap → merge → LLM (OpenRouter) only when evidence exists → answer + confidence + sources + claims.
decisions: Canonical YAML knowledge is the source of truth.
Retrieval failure must refuse rather than use the model's latent biography.
Fast path answers come from structured knowledge, not a second hardcoded resume.
projects.challenges: Duplicate marketing copy vs source notes; inflated metrics in earlier UI.
projects.solutions: Claim taxonomy, provenance, honest FITMAN status, refusal when evidence is missing.
projects.results: Implemented in this repository. No published latency SLA.
projects.limitations: Dense retrieval depends on Pinecone being indexed with current knowledge. Lexical search works locally from YAML even if Pinecone is empty.
projects.future_improvements: Cross-encoder rerank, reproducible eval harness with live models.
